title: Admin

users.title: Users
users.rejectConfirm: Reject this user? (They move to "Rejected" and can apply again with the same e-mail.)

sync.title: Google Sheets
sync.daily: Syncs automatically every morning at 7:30 (meetings, patrols, attachments).

roster.title: Staff roster
roster.body: Names offered in the meeting participants and patrol staff pickers. Use the same name as in the shift table. Set people who left to "inactive" (their records stay).
roster.name: Name (as in the shift table)

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.missingChorei: Meetings without record or reason (7 days)

choreiList.title: Meeting records
choreiList.legend: ✓ recorded (tap for details) / ✓ok held, confirmed by a manager / 🔥👥🧍❓✏️ not held, reason reported / ✗ no record and no reason (from 30 min after the meeting) / ― not yet. Tap ✗, a reason or ✓ok to correct it.

stats.title: Reports
stats.scaleNote: Checks without ⑤ (out of 20) are converted to 25. The line is the target 20. ( ) = count.
stats.rankingNote: Each patrol score (on 25) is counted for everyone selected as "staff" in that patrol, then averaged. Patrols recorded as "everyone" are not included. Scores rate the whole shift.
stats.name: Name

hours.title: Patrol time
hours.note: Actual minutes from Start to End of valid patrols (not rounded up).
hours.reviewFirst: Some patrols need a time review. Confirm them before totalling.

settings.usersSub: Approval, roles, patrol members, full names
settings.rosterSub: Staff names for meetings and patrols
settings.shiftImportSub: Load the monthly shift table and show staff their schedule
settings.notifySub: E-mail managers when a report comes in

targets.title: Target bowls
targets.empty: No targets for this month yet. The meeting form cannot pre-fill the target.
targets.fillAll: Enter a number (0 or more) in every box.

testPeriod: Before 10/12 is the test period and is not counted
countNote: Counting starts on 10/12 (operation start). Earlier records are test data and excluded.

shiftRequests.title: Shift requests
shiftRequests.export: Export to Excel (早番希望・中番希望・遅番希望)
shiftRequests.note: The exported sheets have the same layout as 早番希望 / 中番希望 / 遅番希望 in the shift workbook.

shiftImport.title: Import shift table
shiftImport.note: Pick the shift workbook (.xlsm). Only the 早番 / 中番 / 遅番 sheets are read, on this device. The file is not uploaded.
shiftImport.noLinked: None yet (set "shift-table name" on the Users screen)
shiftImport.overwrite: This month already has {{n}} rows. Importing replaces them.

notify.title: Notification e-mails
notify.body: When a report (朝礼, patrol, shift request, …) comes in, the addresses below are notified. Addresses of people without an app account can be added too.
notify.name: Name (optional)
notify.urgentNote: Same-day coaching and new sign-ups (including re-applications) are sent at once, also to digest recipients. Test accounts never notify.

staff.title: By staff
staff.rule: Same person, same kind of point 3 times in 30 days → interview needed. 3 more times after an interview → measures proposed (also by e-mail).
staff.pickHint: Choose a staff member to see their improvement points, good points and interviews.
staff.interviewNeeded: Pointed out {{n}} times in the last 30 days. Please plan a coaching interview.
staff.notePlaceholder: What you said, the answer, the goal agreed
staff.measurePlaceholder: e.g. the manager checks again in 2 weeks
staff.noPatrols: No patrol with this staff member yet.

choreiEdit.title: Edit the 朝礼 record
choreiEdit.filesHint: You can add photos and videos. Up to 5 photos and 1 video in total, including the ones already there.
choreiEdit.historyNote: The sent time ({{at}}) does not change. This history is shown on manager screens only.

misses.title: Why 朝礼 were not held (period)
misses.none: No 朝礼 without a record in this period.
misses.unreported: No record and no reason reported
misses.confirmed: Held, confirmed by a manager (no record)
misses.markDoneHint: Opens the 朝礼 form with this date, shift and store. The sent time will be the meeting time; you can add a manager note and photos/videos.
misses.enteredByManager: Recorded afterwards by a manager (sent time = meeting time)

patrolBackfill.title: Record a past patrol
patrolBackfill.banner: A manager records a patrol that could not be entered at the time. Patrol time goes to the patrol member you choose.
patrolBackfill.timesHint: Enter the actual times (e.g. 2:00–2:12). Late-night times of a 遅番 are on the next calendar day.
patrolBackfill.endAfterStart: The end must be after the start.
patrolBackfill.photosHint: Photos and videos are optional; you can pick them from the gallery.
patrolBackfill.notePlaceholder: e.g. Could not be entered at the time because of an app problem.
patrolBackfill.entered: Patrol recorded afterwards by a manager
